title: FISHER: No location information
body:
I'm sure I'm doing something wrong, but I can't seem to get the fisher UI to display anything besides my current bait, moving around doesn't seem to update anything and nothing shows up when I'm casting.

I went to a few different places just to see if it was a specific area but no luck.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Forgot to mention, Cast time stays at 0.0 no matter what and location is just @ -------------

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
When you unpacked the zip, did you make sure to go to properties and check "Unblock".
That might be the first thing to start with.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: almost positive i did since i remember fixing it when i got an error about it

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: game connection is successful, combat information shows up in the main tab, not sure what's going wrong, did a fresh install of cactbot too just in case something got blocked

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
having the same issue. no cast time, fish or locations will show while fishing. DPS meter and raid plugins work just fine. 

![fishingerror](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39010252/54578955-da410000-49d7-11e9-800a-e1a361447e80.PNG)

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body: Can you paste some log lines from when you are casting?

comments.author: Participant 5
comments.body:
It's an issue on the user's end.
I've had the same issue initially on my end.

Character Configuration > Log Window Settings > Log Filters > Announcements > Own Gathering Messages

Own Gathering Messages has to be checked in order for the game to log the data needed by the module.

comments.author: Participant 6
comments.body: I was having this issue as well and it turns out the "Hide Chat Log (for privacy)" in the FFXIV plugin for ACT prevents the fisher module from detecting when the line is cast; at least for me anyways.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
